cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(HWDER C CXX)

# HWDER: Hyrule Warriors: Definitive Edition static recompilation.
# The game's code (all ExeFS modules) is generated by tools/recomp/gen_main.py into generated/.
# Build with clang-cl (VS 2022 LLVM toolset): needs musttail, __int128 and GNU builtins.
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded")

set(GEN_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/generated)
set(TP ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party)
include(${GEN_DIR}/sources.cmake)

set(HW_ARCH_FLAGS /arch:AVX2 -mfma -mf16c -maes -mpclmul -msse4.2)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- recompiled game code
add_library(hwder_game STATIC ${RECOMP_SOURCES} ${GEN_DIR}/functable.c ${GEN_DIR}/module_info.c)
target_include_directories(hwder_game PUBLIC runtime/include ${GEN_DIR})
target_compile_options(hwder_game PRIVATE ${HW_ARCH_FLAGS} /O2 /Z7 -Wno-everything -fno-strict-aliasing)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- SDL3: host gamepads only
# Static, with only what controllers need (joystick/gamepad, haptic, sensors, HIDAPI drivers for
# DualSense / DualShock 4 / Switch Pro). No window, renderer or audio: HWDER has its own.
set(SDL_STATIC ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_TEST_LIBRARY OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_LIBC ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
foreach(sub AUDIO VIDEO GPU RENDER CAMERA POWER DIALOG)
    set(SDL_${sub} OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
endforeach()
foreach(sub JOYSTICK HAPTIC HIDAPI SENSOR)
    set(SDL_${sub} ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
endforeach()
add_subdirectory(${TP}/SDL ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/SDL EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- runtime: HOS kernel, services, GPU
# Explicit lists: the checkout path may contain [ ] which CMake globs treat as patterns.
set(RUNTIME_SOURCES
    runtime/src/core.cpp
    runtime/src/threads.cpp
    runtime/src/config.cpp
    runtime/src/version.cpp
    runtime/src/kernel/kernel.cpp
    runtime/src/kernel/memory.cpp
    runtime/src/kernel/svc.cpp
    runtime/src/service/ipc.cpp
    runtime/src/service/sm.cpp
    runtime/src/service/applet.cpp
    runtime/src/service/misc.cpp
)
foreach(sub hid fs audio gpu gpu/vk shader video game interp)
    include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/runtime/src/${sub}/sources.cmake)
endforeach()
add_executable(hwder ${RUNTIME_SOURCES})

# Version stamp: regenerated on every build (always out of date), rewritten only when it changes.
set(HW_VERSION_DIR ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/version)
add_custom_target(hwder_version
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -DSRC=${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR} -DOUT=${HW_VERSION_DIR}/hwder_version.h
            -P ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/version.cmake
    BYPRODUCTS ${HW_VERSION_DIR}/hwder_version.h
    COMMENT "Stamping version"
    VERBATIM)
add_dependencies(hwder hwder_version)
target_include_directories(hwder PRIVATE ${HW_VERSION_DIR})
target_link_libraries(hwder PRIVATE hwder_game SDL3::SDL3-static dbghelp winmm synchronization psapi bcrypt)
target_include_directories(hwder PRIVATE runtime/src ${TP}/vulkan-headers/include ${TP}/spirv-headers/include ${TP}/imgui ${TP}/imgui/backends)
target_compile_definitions(hwder PRIVATE NOMINMAX WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN IMGUI_IMPL_VULKAN_NO_PROTOTYPES IMGUI_IMPL_VULKAN_USE_LOADER IMGUI_DISABLE_OBSOLETE_FUNCTIONS IMGUI_USER_CONFIG="gpu/hwder_imconfig.h")
target_compile_options(hwder PRIVATE ${HW_ARCH_FLAGS} /Z7 /O2 /EHsc -Wno-everything)
target_link_options(hwder PRIVATE /DEBUG /STACK:16777216 /DYNAMICBASE:NO /FIXED:NO)
